risks.proof: Close-up photos of injector pump, wiring loom, and internal cylinder bores (borescope if possible)

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete or missing ancillaries (turbo, ECU, injector pump) since it sits among many stripped engines in a yard

risks.risk: Possible mixing of parts from multiple engines in the pile (mismatched components)
risks.proof: Photo showing this specific engine isolated, with matching serial numbers on block and ancillaries
risks.if_unproven: priced with uncertainty discount for mismatched parts

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/hours and unknown exact DAF engine model/displacement beyond '24 valve' marking

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running (with sound) to confirm it is operational
Clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate for exact model and specification
Photos showing the engine fully separated from the pile, with turbo, ECU, and wiring harness visible
Close-up of internal bores or oil condition (dipstick, filter) to assess wear
Confirmation of hours/mileage if available from documentation
response.reason: The item is identifiable by brand and type as a used DAF 24-valve inline-6 trailer-head engine, but all condition claims are unverified or contradicted by visible grime and outdoor storage, so it must be priced at worst-case (unverified running condition, possible incompleteness) pending the listed proofs.
